queries.query: Elmhurst Illinois official parcel map GIS property viewer DuPage County
queries.result: Found the official DuPage County Parcel Viewer documentation and the current official DuPage County ArcGIS parcel service. The service metadata identifies the ParcelsRealEstate polygon layer and public GeoJSON query support.

queries.query: Elmhurst Illinois official cadastral parcel GIS map
queries.result: A separate first-party wording search also located the official DuPage County parcel layer and the DuPage County property-information route; no separate Elmhurst municipal cadastral service was evidenced.

localCustodian.name: DuPage County Information Technology Department, GIS Division, in conjunction with the DuPage County Clerk
localCustodian.evidence: The official layer description says the polygon dataset is created and maintained by the county GIS division with the county clerk for visual and spatial representation of deeds, rights-of-way, and subdivision plats; bounded anonymous queries returned Elmhurst-area parcel polygons. This is county-level custodianship covering Elmhurst, not a separately identified municipal registry office.

generalAgency.name: DuPage County property lookup
generalAgency.scope: General public property-tax lookup context; not used for geometry and not treated as the parcel GIS API.

sample.selection: First three polygons returned by the bounded WGS84 envelope query; retained properties contain only the native OBJECTID identity.

runtimeReadiness.reason: A real public county parcel source and safe native identities/geometries were evidenced, but runtime admission remains held pending independent serial adapter qualification.
